scripts.api-report: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/year-planner-core api-report && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/react-year-planner api-report
scripts.verify: pnpm test:toolchain && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm api-report:ci && pnpm test:size && pnpm storybook:build && pnpm docs:build && pnpm pack:check
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:consumer
scripts.api-report:ci: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/year-planner-core api-report:ci && pnpm --filter @blendsdk/react-year-planner api-report:ci
scripts.docs:build: typedoc --options typedoc.core.json && typedoc --options typedoc.react.json && cp docs/api-index.html docs/api/index.html
